title: Add manual go-live checks with current sender and penny rules
public_pr_body:
Reuses the existing builder-2 checklist for chasing, bank checking, costing, timesheet emails and customer payment claims. Updates the expected sender comparison to ignore plus-addressing and adds explicit fractional-penny refusal. Each click has an expected result; missing wiring is marked BLOCKED rather than presented as working.

Only tests/MANUAL-CHECKS.md is added. No docs/ files, runtime changes, emails, migrations or deployments. Diff check passed; full Vitest, TypeScript and ESLint verification is running and will be recorded on codex/work-ownership.
